what: Scout multistatic UWB radar, end to end on the simulator of this tree (sandtable/scout/sim.py, adapted from lane L08's tagless-uwb-echo-radar, L08's noise model): scene -> simulate -> self_locate -> static_echoes -> register into the twin -> find_victims -> find_mismatches, plus shadow.locate on the same ranges. The simulator was written alongside the detector; real boards will do worse.

noise_model.carrier_phase: U(0, 2 pi) per frame: free-running radios share no oscillator
noise_model.sampling_offset: U(0, 1) tap per frame: the receiver's sampling grid is not locked to the pulse
noise_model.adc: rounded to integer counts; 10000 counts = direct-path peak at 1 m
noise_model.path_loss: amplitude 1/path for direct and specular paths (Friis); sqrt(rcs/4pi)/(R1 R2) for scatterers
noise_model.shadow: ITU-R P.526 knife edge from the body's clearance to each line of sight, in Fresnel radii, capped at 25 dB
noise_model.not_modelled: antenna patterns (except the ceiling term), second-order bounces, floor bounce, wall transmission, smoke/heat effects on the radio (negligible at 6.5 GHz), the crew at the door, chip artefacts, clock drift

definitions.reported: find_victims returned a victim (2 pucks: presence only, no position)
definitions.within_X: reported and within X m of the true victim, in the twin frame (registration errors included)
definitions.error_m: distance from the reported to the true victim among reported scans (median, 90th percentile, max)
definitions.bpm_error: |reported - true| breaths per minute among reported scans
definitions.range_right: two pucks: reported extra path within one tap (0.300 m) of the true one
definitions.self_location.error_after_alignment_m: RMS puck error of self_locate after the best rotation, mirror and offset
definitions.registration.puck_rms_m: RMS distance of the registered pucks from the true pucks in the twin frame, per scan
definitions.wrong_pose: registration puck RMS above 0.5 m (a mirrored or turned constellation)
definitions.confident: register()['confident'] (ambiguity < 0.7 and 5 or more echoes matched)
definitions.ambiguous_ge_0.6: ambiguity >= 0.6: the session adds an 'ambiguous registration' limit to the scan
definitions.door_decided: the echoes fit another pose about as well and the door prior chose
definitions.debris.flagged_within_0.8m: an unexpected_reflector flag within 0.8 m of the true debris
definitions.debris.false_reflector_flags: unexpected_reflector flags farther than 0.8 m from the debris (flags_on_the_victim: of those, within 1.0 m of the victim)
definitions.debris_with_victim_known: the same with the located victim passed to find_mismatches(known=...); the live session does not pass it
definitions.shadow: shadow.locate on the same ranges with the registered pucks, no baseline (cross-link fit)

leakage_audit.runtime_guard: rec.pop('truth') before self_locate, static_echoes, register, find_victims, find_mismatches and shadow.locate; the scene dict is never passed to them

dsp.py: 3: Pure numpy. Input is a recording (sim.simulate, or real pucks in the same shape); `rec["truth"]` is never read.

development_seed_check.what: the same pipeline on the development seeds 300-315 ('reach' scene), to compare with the ad-hoc numbers in sandtable/scout/RADAR_NOTES.md (5 pucks: 9/16 reported, 8/16 within 0.6 m)

still_victim_check.what: a victim who neither breathes nor moves, same placement rule as 'reach': a detector that knew the position would find them; this one must not
